description: This traditional handvo recipe is inspired from very talented @nigamthakkarrecipes. I loved his perfect Handva recipe. Handva is one thing which previously never made in my home kitchen. But all the credit and thanks to Nigam Bhai who is so kind that he sent me Handva Cooker so Yes Now Handva is my family favorite dish too.  Ingredients: Handva Flour: 3 Cup Rice 1 Cup Split Black Gram 1 Cup Toor Dal 1 Cup Chana Dal 1 tbsp Fenugreek Seeds  Handva Batter: 3 Cup Handva Flours Buttermilk 1 tsp Sugar 1/2 tsp Crushed Fenugreek Seeds  Other Ingredients: 2 tsp Ginger Chilly Paste 1 inch Ginger Salt to Taste 1/4 tsp Turmeric Powder 4 tbsp Oil 1/2 tsp Baking Soda 1 tsp Warm Water Sesame Seeds  For Tadka: 4 tbsp Oil 1/2 tsp Mustard Seeds 10-12 Curry Leaves 1/4 tsp Asafoetida 2 tsp Sesame Seeds 2 Dry Red Chillies 1/2 tsp Red Chilly Powder  You can watch Nigam Thakkar's Traditional Handva Recipe Here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nsz3IXsR-ds&t=29s  #handvo_recipe #virajnaikrecipes #gujarati_farsan #handvo_in_cooker #gujarati_food #gujarati_khana #traditional_recipe #handva_recipe_in_hindi #gujarati_rasoi  Follow me on Facebook :  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/virajnaikrecipes  Follow me on Instagram : Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/virajnaikrecipes  Camera: Vijay Patel Director: Jignesh Patel Location: CK Party Plot | Dhamdachha  I wish you all a happy and healthy life. Thank You!! Viraj Naik
